description: Daily login reward pack. Lower hero drop rates to prevent hero saturation.

guarantees.description: Last card is guaranteed Uncommon or better (NO hero guarantee)

heroRestriction.description: Heroes drop at 30% normal rate. Epic heroes only (no Legendary)

pitySystem.description: Epic every 15 daily packs, Hero (any rarity up to Epic) every 10 daily packs

designNotes.purpose: Prevent hero saturation from daily freebies. Most cards are Commons/Uncommons for deck building, not collection completion.
designNotes.heroRate: ~3% natural rate (vs 10-15% in standard packs), max Epic rarity
designNotes.balance: Players get units/tactics/buildings for deckbuilding, heroes remain special
